messages:
megan: seeing ~11% gpu-attach failures in eu-north1 since 14:22 UTC, provisioner logs show 'attach_wait_disk' and nvme io timeouts. hitting capacity for retries.
vik: any deploys or janitor changes?
rafa: we rolled a scrub concurrency bump (ephemeral-cleaner.concurrency 3 -> 9) yesterday at 13:50 to clear old tempfiles in eu-north1.
peering-bot: peering-event: BGP flap with partner-net at 14:17 UTC, a subset of routes briefly re-announced with lower MTU metadata.
megan: iostat from node eu-n1-76 at 14:21:
```
Device       r/s     w/s   rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1      0.1  312.4    0.0 19968    64.0    13.44  42.3  0.13 100.0
```
rafa: avgqu ~13 and %util 100%  classic writeback pile-up. dmesg from same host shows repeated: "nvme nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout".
vik: partner MTU mismatch could cause packet fragmentation -> objectstore PUTs take longer -> clients retry syncs -> local fsyncs block. any S3 retry spike?
megan: yes s3-client retry_rate spiked x6 between 14:16-14:24 in eu-north1. stack traces show synchronous checkpoint flush path waiting on write.
rafa: so combined: higher scrub concurrency + peering-induced objectstore retries -> writeback tail -> nvme queue saturates -> gpu attach waits on local ephemerals.
oncall-sre: acknowledged. propose mitigation: 1) set ephemeral-cleaner.concurrency back to 2 for eu-north1, 2) flip kernel tunables vm.dirty_ratio=5 and vm.dirty_bytes=33554432, 3) temporarily prefer eu-west1 for new GPU requests for 45m, 4) pause firmware/cleanup rollouts to that cohort.
vik: applying flag flip for cleaner: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"key":"ephemeral-cleaner.concurrency","value":"2","scope":"eu-north1"}'`
peering-bot: flag-change detected: ephemeral-cleaner.concurrency 9 -> 2 by infra-deploy at 14:29 UTC.
megan: after patching first 30% hosts attach failure rate dropped 11.2% -> 2.4% in ~6m. good signal.
rafa: added short-term alert: nvme.avgqu > 10 AND provisioner.attach_errors > 3% -> page storage oncall.
overview: routing override enacted: routing-policy 'avoid:eu-north1,prefer:eu-west1' for 45m. note: cost impact estimate +12% on spot GPU price and reduced available capacity for latency-sensitive jobs. ops: budget notified.
vik: creating STORAGE-532 ticket with timeline, host iostats, dmesg snippets, and peering logs. recommend: 1) run staging test combining high scrub concurrency + simulated objectstore retries, 2) add network-aware rate-limiter to ephemeral-cleaner, 3) partner peering team to confirm MTU & retransmit tuning.
megan: also capturing nvme.temp, nvme.smart_warn_count to look for any underlying drive health issues.
oncall-sre: incident INC-2026-140 opened, paging storage, network, and release. please attach node list and full traces. :rotating_light: :eyes:
